scope: Operator-run Windows deployment; scripts never silently sign institution acceptance or switch Apache.

update: Stop other writing jobs. Update.ps1 verifies next package first, maintains current, verifies backup, copies current .env and storage/app, updates only Python path, migrates next release and checks acceptance.

After browser/admin/personnel proof, point Apache and scheduled tasks to next public root; artisan up. Do not change APP_KEY.
rollback: Use Rollback.ps1 -Previous <known release> -Current <current release> -Target <NEW directory> -SchemaCompatibilityConfirmed only after current-schema compatibility is reviewed.
Rollback prepares previous code with CURRENT .env and private/public files; leaves database and original releases intact; never calls migrate:rollback or imports an older dump.
If schema compatibility is absent, stop in maintenance and use reviewed data reconciliation; no blind SQL downgrade.

Backup.ps1 performs maintenance/verified backup/up; failure leaves maintenance. Stop other writing tasks during backups.
Restrict NTFS ACL for .env, storage/app and backup/restore folders. Apache serves only public; do not publish backups.

Admin-only /yonetim/saglik shows version, DB, latest backup/job and privacy-safe route/error/query maxima.
Complete deploy/acceptance/checklist.json on the target machine and preserve evidence with exact release hash. Windows execution and institution approval are distinct from local macOS tests.
